text:
deploybot: PREDEPLOY CHECK: release paused — env parity mismatch detected for INFERENCE_CACHE_TTL between staging and prod. staging: \"30s\" (string with suffix), prod: \"30\" (integer). failing policy: numeric-tokenization.
claire: ack. that could break the autoscaler/eviction code that expects an int.
tom: confirm — the runtime calls `parseDuration` for values with suffixes and `atoi` for plain ints. mixed inputs cause the new parsing path to return ms instead of sec.
rachel: so if we promote this, memory pressure could spike in prod after rollout. we should not proceed.
leo: can we normalize by changing staging to the integer format? is that a quick patch?
claire: yes, low-risk to change staging values to match prod. but we should also add a compatibility shim in parsing code to be safe.
infra-bot: NOTE: change window for this release closes at 2026-03-21T23:30:00Z. any hold beyond that requires approval.
tom: i'll open a tiny PR that converts TTL values in `helm/values/staging.yaml` and adds a unit test asserting TTL is an int. will also add a pre-commit check for duration suffixes in helm values.
deploybot: release remains paused. add PR URL when ready.
claire: ops check — @ops-bot, can you scan configmaps and k8s secrets for TTL-like keys with non-integer values across prod namespaces?
ops-bot: running scan: `kubectl get cm,secret --all-namespaces -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.namespace}:{.metadata.name}{"\n"}{end}'` then grepping for TTL keys. initial pass found: `staging-inference:inference-config` -> `INFERENCE_CACHE_TTL=30s`, `canary-inference:inference-config` -> `INFERENCE_CACHE_TTL=30`. no prod matches with suffix. full list will take ~90s.
rachel: good. looks like only staging slipped. still want to run a small canary in staging after merge.
leo: timeline proposal: tom opens PR -> claire reviews -> merge -> run `deploycheck` -> deploy to staging -> 20m canary -> run load smoke tests -> unpause.
claire: +1. also pin the service image to current digest for 1h after unpause to avoid auto-roll forward.
tom: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1301 — updates staging values, adds linter, unit test.
deploybot: noted. release paused until `deploycheck` passes.
infra-bot: added changelog entry draft: "fix: normalize INFERENCE_CACHE_TTL format in staging values to match prod; added lint to prevent duration suffix accidentally committed". include in release notes.
claire: also add a follow-up ticket to audit all parsing code paths that handle TTLs; if someone accidentally writes `5m` later we should handle it gracefully.
ops-bot: config scan complete: only the one staging CM with `30s` found. no prod configmaps or secrets with suffix TTLs.
rachel: merging once CI is green. if deploycheck fails post-merge, we rollback and open incident.
claire: thank you — keeping this release paused probably avoided a nasty regression. please paste smoke test results into this thread after the canary. :thumbsup:
